purpose: event option material only; retain scene background

payload.input:
no humans, a single blank wide horizontal game decision banner, mineral-white coated archival paper laminated over dark slate-blue ink, front orthographic view, isolated graphic design material

Original painted interface material for a winter-city exploration event choice. The center is an uninterrupted pale ivory writing area; no text, no symbols, no scenery.

One continuous horizontal banner spanning almost the full canvas width, centered vertically, approximately five times wider than tall. Straight left edge with a narrow dark registration tab, subtly irregular dry-brush feathered right edge, calm blank central 80 percent. Plain neutral dark background around the banner.

Matte chalk white, very pale gray-green, desaturated charcoal blue. Delicate edge fibers and layered painted ink only at the perimeter, broad clean central color, no glossy bevel, no glow, no metal frame.

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
